summary.text: Cole Conley is a Republican member of the North Dakota Senate, representing District 12 (Jamestown) in the 2025-26 Legislative Assembly. The legislature's biography lists Cole Conley's service as "Senate since 2021". The member page lists Cole Conley's committee assignments as including the Appropriations standing committee.

paragraphs.text: The biography lists Cole Conley's occupation as Retired Farmer/Businessman.
It lists education as Attended UND.
It lists these affiliations and civic roles: Elks.
Cole Conley is listed as a widower with 3 children and 10 grandchildren.
